initialExam.title: Bihar Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Bihar Police Constable recruitment for various constable posts across Bihar state police, home guard, and fire services.
initialExam.syllabus: Hindi, English, GK, Current Affairs, Mathematics, Science, Bihar GK.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. PET. Medical.
